decisions.reason: The encrypted second channel remains a core building block of the firm's secure-ecosystem and binding-communication strategy, and it is cheap to maintain alongside the established platform, so the option is still worth holding even though it was not visible on the website in 2020 to 2021.
As a platform-level architecture that underpins the other identity and mobile security offers, dropping it would destroy many follow-on options, while keeping it costs little.

Four years after launch, app-based strong authentication has largely displaced dedicated hardware tokens after PSD2, and the product's absence from the website signals that its value is unlikely to be realized, so its hardware costs are better redirected to app-based identity development.
Payment security compliance demand persists, so the option still has plausible value, although its lack of visibility since 2020 suggests weak traction that management should keep watching.
